extraction.notes: Three months ended 6/30/2022 column. Company has no AFFO metric; affo fields null. Arithmetic checks: -4,598 + adjustments = 19,085 FFO; 19,085 + core adjustments = 21,016 Core FFO. Diluted shares 18,826 reproduces $1.02 FFO (19,245/18,826) and $1.12 Core FFO (21,176/18,826) per share. 'Technology implementation costs' (footnote: two-year implementation) was categorized as 'other' since it is not clearly a severance/restructuring or software-transition item. The only capex disclosure on S-15 is total same-store capital expenditures per apartment home ($196), a per-unit total rather than recurring capex, and the company reports no AFFO, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Core FFO per-share figure reported as the company's 'Core FFO per share and Unit - diluted'."
